# Indusolutions

Client. A specialist transport and logistics business in Kenwick, Western Australia - concrete panel transport on PrefaMAX trailers, drop deck and refrigeration - serving builders, precast and civil clients in Perth and regional WA. It has its own IT department, which manages its domain and email.
